news.title: Missing Florida teen’s truck found in Atlanta; deputies ask public for help
news.summary: Authorities are asking people in the Atlanta area to help find a missing 16-year-old Florida boy whose truck was found abandoned in the city.

news.title: Restaurant shooting leaves 1 dead after suspect allegedly says victim was sleeping with his wife
news.summary: A man was killed and two other people were injured by glass fragments during a shooting outside a Doraville restaurant early Sunday morning, police said.

news.title: DeKalb County neighbors hear explosion before fatal house fire
news.summary: One person is dead, and two others are injured after a heavy fire tore through a three-story home on Lake Drive in DeKalb County on Saturday night, according to fire officials.

news.title: Man killed in Buford Highway shooting over alleged affair
news.summary: A personal dispute outside a Buford Highway eatery erupted into deadly gunfire early Sunday, leaving a man dead and two restaurant patrons hurt by shattered glass, Doraville police said.

news.title: 'I killed him': Suspect accused of killing man he believed was sleeping with his wife at Doraville restaurant
news.summary: Officers stopped the truck and detained Roman-Cortez. During the encounter, he reportedly told officers, “I shot him, I killed him.”

news.title: Man surrenders after teen killed outside Jonesboro apartments
news.summary: A 26-year-old man surrendered to Clayton County police Sunday in connection with the fatal shooting of 16-year-old Jayden Miller outside an apartment complex in Jonesboro.
